title: Catalog
description: The bookshelf (content/catalog.json): which stories the app offers, in shelf order, and which are free or paid. Hand-edited. `story package` turns it into the catalog the app downloads (schema/published-catalog.schema.json). See docs/story-format.md.

access.description: Free stories are open to everyone. A paid one opens once its product is bought (behind the parental gate).

product.description: Store product id of the one-time purchase that unlocks a paid story, the same id on the App Store and Google Play (lowercase letters, digits, '_' and '.'; Google Play allows no '-').

approved.description: The languages approved for the production channel (release builds), the story's first language included only if it's listed. The story is published there in these and no other, once every picture is delivered. A translation listed must be approved by a native speaker too (its status in translations/<lang>.json). Without this list the story isn't published to production. The draft channel has every language.
